title: Destination safety checks
summary: Protect people who click short links from deceptive destinations by refusing, at creation time, URLs that point to blocklisted domains, use raw IP addresses as hosts, or embed credentials (user:password@host), which are common phishing techniques. Refusals use a dedicated problem type so clients can explain them.
functionalRequirements: Reject destinations whose host is a blocklisted domain or a subdomain of one
Reject destinations whose host is an IP address literal (IPv4, IPv6, or numeric/hex encodings)
Reject destinations containing user info (credentials) before the host
Return 422 with problem type urn:problem:unsafe-destination and a reason
Configure the blocklist and the IP-literal rule through application configuration
nonFunctionalRequirements: No impact on redirect latency: checks run only on creation
No network calls on the create path
Rejected URLs are not logged (they may contain credentials)

acceptanceCriteria.description: Creating a link to a blocklisted domain or any of its subdomains returns 422 urn:problem:unsafe-destination
Destinations with IPv4, IPv6, decimal or hex IP hosts are rejected when block-ip-literals is enabled
Destinations with embedded credentials (user:pass@host) are rejected
The blocklist is configurable via shortener.safety.blocked-domains without code changes
Domains that only share a suffix string (notphishing.test vs phishing.test) and ordinary URLs are not affected

assumptions: Blocklist matching is by registrable domain suffix on label boundaries
Existing links are not re-validated (no retroactive blocking in this iteration)
Static configuration is sufficient until a reputation service is chosen

ambiguities.question: Which threat should this change address first?
options: Malicious or deceptive destination URLs (phishing, malware)
ambiguities.recommendedOption: Malicious or deceptive destination URLs (phishing, malware)

ambiguities.question: What should happen when a destination is considered unsafe?
options: Reject the link at creation time with a clear error
